<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">9:41</text>
    <line x1="330" y1="22" x2="330" y2="27" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="20" x2="335" y2="27" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="18" x2="340" y2="27" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="354" cy="23" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="358" y1="27" x2="363" y2="20" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="369" y="18" width="16" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="20" width="11" height="6" rx="1" fill="#F5C418"/>
    <rect x="385" y="21" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,57 22,66 31,75" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="48" y="72" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Filter</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="315" y="50" width="55" height="32" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
      <text x="342.5" y="71" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Reset</text>
    </g>
  </g>
  <line x1="20" y1="96" x2="370" y2="96" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Sort section -->
  <text x="20" y="126" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Sort by</text>
  <g>
    <circle cx="31" cy="157" r="9" fill="#F5C418" stroke="#F5C418" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="31" cy="157" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="49" y="162" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Popularity</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="150" cy="157" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#91919F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="168" y="162" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Rating</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="247" cy="157" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#91919F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="265" y="162" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Release date</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="20" y1="184" x2="370" y2="184" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Genre -->
  <text x="20" y="215" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Genre</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="232" width="75" height="34" rx="17" fill="#F5C418"/>
    <text x="57.5" y="254" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Action</text>
    <rect x="103" y="232" width="82" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
    <text x="144" y="254" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Comedy</text>
    <rect x="193" y="232" width="75" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
    <text x="230.5" y="254" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Drama</text>
    <rect x="276" y="232" width="94" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
    <text x="323" y="254" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Thriller</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="276" width="91" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
    <text x="65.5" y="298" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Romance</text>
    <rect x="119" y="276" width="91" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
    <text x="164.5" y="298" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Animation</text>
    <rect x="218" y="276" width="81" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
    <text x="258.5" y="298" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Horror</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="20" y1="330" x2="370" y2="330" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Country selector -->
  <text x="20" y="361" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Country</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="377" width="350" height="48" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
    <text x="36" y="407" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">United States</text>
    <polyline points="347,397 355,405 363,397" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="20" y1="445" x2="370" y2="445" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Rating -->
  <text x="20" y="476" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Rating</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="492" width="163" height="42" rx="8" fill="#F5C418" fill-opacity="0.14" stroke="#F5C418"/>
    <text x="36" y="518" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Any rating</text>
    <polyline points="153,508 159,514 165,508" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="195" y="492" width="175" height="42" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
    <text x="211" y="518" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Minimum score</text>
    <polyline points="340,508 346,514 352,508" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="20" y1="554" x2="370" y2="554" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Year -->
  <text x="20" y="585" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Year</text>
  <text x="20" y="606" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">Select one or more release years</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="618" width="74" height="34" rx="17" fill="#F5C418"/>
    <text x="57" y="640" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">2024</text>
    <rect x="102" y="618" width="74" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
    <text x="139" y="640" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">2023</text>
    <rect x="184" y="618" width="74" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
    <text x="221" y="640" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">2022</text>
    <rect x="266" y="618" width="74" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
    <text x="303" y="640" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">2021</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="678" width="112" height="48" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#333333"/>
    <text x="76" y="708" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Cancel</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="142" y="679" width="228" height="48" rx="8" fill="#0000001A"/>
    <rect x="142" y="677" width="228" height="48" rx="8" fill="#F2C94C"/>
    <text x="256" y="707" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Apply filters</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="38,797 48,788 58,797 58,808 51,808 51,801 45,801 45,808 38,808" fill="#F2C94C"/>
    <polyline points="36,798 48,787 60,798" fill="none" stroke="#F2C94C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="48" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#F2C94C">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="133" cy="798" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="139" y1="804" x2="145" y2="810" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="133" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Search</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <polyline points="215,793 215,808 225,812 235,808 235,793" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="215" y1="793" x2="225" y2="797" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="797" x2="235" y2="793" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="225" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Wishlist</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="318" cy="795" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="318" cy="806" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="318" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
